description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_DenyElementDecorator' which acts as a decorator to disable certain CSS properties for specific HTML elements, by wrapping an existing attribute definition and adding element-specific denial logic.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_DenyElementDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that disables CSS properties for specific elements during validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with the underlying attribute definition and the target element to deny.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the current token matches the denied element; if so, disables validation, otherwise delegates to the wrapped definition.
